method: Compare all 173 bundled entries to report Table A2 and v16 country-year data for 2025. Dataset scores have three decimal places: allow +/-0.005 rounding; ranks are intervals for tied three-decimal values over all 179 units. Rank-change comparison uses 2024 and 2025 in the same v16 dataset; it does not establish the unpublished application calculation.
citation: Coppedge et al. (2026), V-Dem Country-Year Dataset v16, https://doi.org/10.23696/vdemds26. Package: Maerz et al. (2026), vdemdata.
scopeCaveat: PS maps to Palestine/West Bank, not an aggregate for West Bank and Gaza. year=2026 is release year; observations concern 2025.
